entry_conditions: Drawer_position is strictly above 0.26 m, red is exposed, and a reliable current red pose is available. Entry may be at the closed-gripper drawer front or later during red approach, contact, or lift.
exit_conditions: Nominal switch cue: red is within the outside pad and no longer follows TCP; after the retained overlap, blue is centered under TCP with closed fingers and observed blue/TCP co-motion on initial lift. These cues do not alter task success.
overlap_role: The package supervises [230,470) shared with open_drawer and [600,850) shared with blue_insert in every demonstration. This covers drawer release through red lift and final red descent/release through blue pickup/lift.
successor_readiness: blue_insert may receive from index 600 with red still held or touching because release context is included. The least ambiguous nominal handoff is after blue co-motion is established near the cut end.
failure_signatures: Red fails to co-move after closure; transformed approach is unreachable; red is carried into furniture; red is outside the pad or follows TCP after opening; TCP fails to clear red; or blue approach shifts with red rather than current blue.
continuation_guidance: Replan the red anchor from the latest causal observation every chunk. If red has already been released and blue pose variation dominates, prefer the phase-conditioned local policy or hand off to blue_insert rather than relying on red anchoring.
limitations: Observed successful trajectories do not establish recovery from missed grasps, off-pad release, stale object poses, collision, or IK nonconvergence. Closed fingers alone are not proof of grasp.
